title: How should the opening move?
question: Choose the opening sequence to prototype next. The brand stays fixed; the desktop/mobile storyboard and evidence accompany these concepts in chat.

options.label: A: Unfold
options.thesis: Open the inspection object into a mechanical fan.
options.viewport: Large type on the left; a fan opens across the right and aligns with TestPulse. Mobile uses a compact vertical fan.
options.risk: The mechanism is easy to understand, but can suggest a hardware product.

options.label: B: Pass Through
options.thesis: Enter the work through a short opening between material layers.
options.viewport: A close viewing slot reveals TestPulse beyond the object. Mobile uses a much shorter material reveal within a portrait-safe field.
options.risk: Strongest departure from the current site; comfort and smoothness need proof on phones.

options.label: C: Follow
options.thesis: Keep one travelling specimen as the anchor between sections.
options.viewport: A compact object travels into TestPulse while the page stays editorial. Mobile moves the specimen down the portrait composition.
options.risk: Most continuity with the current design; may remain too conservative for the requested leap.
